passages.note: Says a CHP officer may not profile or discriminate against drivers; this is policing conduct under existing law (annex: policing has its own topic), not a position on how far civil rights enforcement should go.
On transgender students in sports he says existing anti-discrimination law must be followed; this belongs to a different topic and names no change to civil rights enforcement either way.
An attack on an opponent's immigration stance as treating immigrants by appearance; it is about immigration and names no civil rights policy clause.

rows.reasoning: None of the sources address what role government should play on racial and social inequality. His remarks on driver profiling, on following anti-discrimination law in school sports, and on immigration are adjacent topics. None names a clause of any rung, such as "strengthen civil rights enforcement and address systemic discrimination" or "eliminate affirmative action and all race-based government programs".
